description: This file defines the OrderRepository class and related functions, which interface with the network API to perform CRUD operations and manage the state of orders within the online shopping platform.

classes.name: OrderRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing orders, providing methods for creation, retrieval, status updates, and cancellation of orders using the network API.

classes.name: OrderFilters
classes.description: A data class encapsulating filter criteria for fetching paged order data.

classes.name: PageResult
classes.description: A generic data class representing a paged set of results with total count.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Creates a new order with specified email and list of product ID and quantity pairs.

methods.name: getOrderById
methods.description: Retrieves an order by its unique ID.

methods.name: fetchOrdersPage
methods.description: Fetches a page of orders based on page index, size, and optional filters.

methods.name: markPaid
methods.description: Updates the order status to PAID.

methods.name: markShipped
methods.description: Updates the order status to SHIPPED.

methods.name: markDelivered
methods.description: Updates the order status to DELIVERED.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the order, setting its status to CANCELLED.
